candidate_sentence_map.S1: Impero A/S reported a resilient financial performance for the fiscal year 2025, characterized by strong revenue growth and significant improvement in profitability metrics, despite initial macroeconomic headwinds.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Total recognized revenue increased by 19% to DKK 42.0 million, up from DKK 35.4 million in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: This growth was primarily driven by commercial momentum in the second half of the year and continued expansion within the company’s core markets of Denmark and the DACH region.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: The cost of sales decreased by 16% to DKK 1.0 million, contributing to an improved gross profit of DKK 41.0 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Profitability saw substantial enhancement, with EBITDA improving to a loss of DKK 3.1 million, a significant positive swing of DKK 5.6 million compared to the DKK 8.7 million loss recorded in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Operating profit also improved, narrowing the deficit to DKK 6.8 million from DKK 11.4 million in the prior year.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: This improvement was supported by a 6% increase in staff costs and a 6% rise in other external expenses, which were more than offset by the 19% revenue growth.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: The company capitalized DKK 5.2 million in development costs, reflecting ongoing investment in product innovation, including the launch of the Control Testing module and AI-integrated features.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: The company’s recurring revenue base strengthened considerably, with Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) reaching DKK 46.2 million at the end of 2025, representing a 19% year-on-year growth.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: This performance landed at the upper end of the revised guidance range.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: SaaS metrics remained robust, highlighted by an exceptionally low churn rate of 1% and a Net Revenue Retention Rate (NRR) of 106%.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: The average revenue per account (ARPA) for new customers reached DKK 204,000, demonstrating the effectiveness of the land-and-expand strategy.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: The customer base expanded to over 200 clients, with notable diversification across industries and a reduction in top-10 customer concentration from 37% in 2020 to 20% in 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Strategically, Impero shifted its focus toward accelerating growth investments rather than pursuing immediate recurring cash flow positivity.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Consequently, the Board deferred the ambition of achieving positive recurring cash flow before the end of 2026.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: To support this strategy and strengthen the balance sheet, the company raised DKK 15 million through a directed equity issue in December 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: This capital injection, combined with existing cash reserves, resulted in a cash position of DKK 18.9 million and equity of DKK 15.4 million at year-end, with no interest-bearing debt.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Looking ahead to 2026, the company guides for ARR between DKK 53 million and DKK 57 million, reflecting expected growth of 15% to 23%, while anticipating an EBITDA range between a DKK 2 million loss and a DKK 1 million profit.
